6a7fbb5bbccc65506bd2aa9751f68b1ad1dc8f0a.summary: Vendor blog by Push (author Dan Green, published 13 Nov 2025). It profiles the extortion collective 'Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters', described as part of The Com, and says its breaches since 2021 begin with account takeover. Examples include EA Games, Nvidia, Snowflake, Red Hat, Discord, help-desk scams hitting MGM Resorts, Caesars, Marks & Spencer and Jaguar Land Rover, and malicious OAuth and browser-extension campaigns. Several victim counts are attacker claims.

hedges: It’s difficult to pin down exactly who the individuals are that make up this criminal collective.
Several counts are attributed to the attacker, e.g. the Salesforce campaign's 1000+ tenants are stated 'according to the attacker'.
The Gainsight breach was allegedly carried out using OAuth tokens stolen in the Salesloft attack.
Data volumes for the Discord breach are what the hackers say.
The CyberHaven attacks were by an unknown threat group; the link to the collective rests on similar modus operandi.
The report says it is highly likely the Jira inside information was used in the later Jaguar Land Rover ransomware breach.
This is a developing situation, with more victims expected to be announced publicly soon.
Less is known about the Caesars breach than the MGM Resorts breach.
